errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload and try again.
errors.noteRequired: Say why the contact agreed (what they said or signed, and where) before recording consent.
errors.settingsInvalid: A keyword needs at least one letter or digit, and at least one STOP keyword must remain while detection is on.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.exportInProgress: A proof file is already being prepared. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.exportNotReady: That file is not ready or has expired. Prepare a new one.
errors.noticeTargetMissing: That widget, booking page or store no longer exists.
errors.notMinor: Guardian consent can only be recorded for a contact marked as a minor.

settings.title: Consent and STOP replies
settings.subtitle: Choose the words that opt a contact out or back in, what we answer, the opt-out line for marketing messages, and whether marketing needs a recorded consent.
settings.conflict: Someone else saved these settings first. The form now shows what is stored.

problems.noOptOutWord: Add at least one STOP keyword, or switch detection off.
problems.badLang: A language code looks like en, ar or pt-BR.

policy.title: Marketing policy
policy.requireConsent: Require recorded consent for marketing sends
policy.requireConsentHint: Off: marketing goes to every contact who has not opted out. On: only to contacts with a recorded consent. Campaign and broadcast audiences show how many were skipped.
policy.withdrawnAlways: Contacts who opted out are always skipped, whatever this switch says.

detect.title: STOP and START replies
detect.enabledHint: When a contact sends only one of the words below, they are opted out or back in on that channel.
detect.autoReplyHint: A short free-text answer inside the 24 hour window, sent once per change. It is not a campaign and does not count as marketing.
detect.rule: The whole message must be the keyword: capital letters, spaces, punctuation, emoji and Arabic diacritics are ignored. "Please stop sending me invoices" or "don't stop" do not match, so nobody is opted out by accident.

lang.title: Language
lang.replyHint: You can use '{{name}}' for the contact's first name. Say how to flip back.
lang.footerHint: Added under marketing texts. Tell people the word to send.
lang.addHint: A language code such as fr or pt-BR.
lang.invalid: Use a code such as fr or pt-BR.

footer.title: The opt-out line
footer.intro: Broadcast and campaign composers can add this line under marketing texts so recipients know they can reply STOP. Approved templates are never changed: put the line in the template itself.
footer.defaultOn: Warn when a marketing text has no opt-out line
footer.defaultOnHint: The composer shows a warning and a one-click button to add it.
footer.noneSet: No opt-out line is set for any language.
footer.sample: Our spring sale starts today. Visit us this week.

test.title: Test a message
test.intro: Type what a contact might send and see what would happen. Nothing is changed or sent. It uses the words above, even before you save.
test.label: Message from a contact
test.failed: The test could not run. Try again.

outcome.opts_out: This opts the contact out of marketing.
outcome.opts_in: This opts the contact back in.
outcome.no_match: Nothing happens: the message is not a keyword.
outcome.detection_off: Nothing happens: detection is switched off.

card.title: Consent
card.noneRecorded: No consent recorded for this contact. Marketing sends follow your workspace policy.

action.utilityGranted: Agreed to be contacted about their request

dialog.introGranted: Record that this contact agreed to receive marketing messages. The reason is kept as proof.
dialog.introWithdrawn: Record that this contact no longer wants marketing messages. They will be skipped by every campaign and broadcast.
dialog.noteHint: For example: signed the paper form at the counter, or agreed by email on 3 March.

privacy.title: Privacy flags
privacy.minorFrom: Set from the date of birth or age given. It lifts by itself on {date}, unless a person keeps it.
privacy.minorFromDeclaration: Set because the age was not confirmed on a form. It stays until a person clears it.

rule.off: Your workspace has not answered the children question in the Compliance center, so marketing to this contact is not held back.
rule.guardian: Marketing to this contact is held back until a parent or guardian's consent is on record.
rule.block: Marketing to this contact is held back, because your workspace says it does not process minors.

privacy.guardianOn: On record since {date}. It is evidence only and does not subscribe the contact.

sale_share_opt_out.on: Opted out of sale and sharing

dialog.title: Record guardian consent
dialog.intro: Record that a parent or guardian agreed. This is evidence only: it does not subscribe the contact to marketing.
dialog.noteHint: For example: signed the paper form at the counter. Do not write the guardian's name or contact details.
dialog.refHint: A form number or document id you can look up later.

composer.missing: This marketing message does not tell people how to opt out. Add a line such as "Reply STOP to unsubscribe".
composer.templateHint: Templates are fixed by their approval. To tell people they can opt out, include a line such as "{line}" in the template itself.

import.label: I have consent to message these contacts
import.hint: Ticked, every contact in the file is recorded as having agreed to marketing, with the file name as proof. Unticked, the import records no consent. Contacts who opted out stay opted out.
import.hintColumn: The column mapped to marketing consent decides who is recorded: only the rows that say yes get a consent, with the file name as proof. A no, a blank cell or an unknown word records nothing. Contacts who opted out stay opted out.
import.columnSummary: {granted} rows say yes and will be recorded. {notGranted} say no or are blank and get no consent record.
import.unrecognised: {count, plural, one {# row has} other {# rows have}} a consent value that is not a yes or a no ({values}). {count, plural, one {It is} other {They are}} treated as not granted. Use yes / no, true / false or 1 / 0.
import.columnIgnored: The consent column does nothing until you tick the box above.
import.noticeTextHint: What these contacts agreed to and where, for example: opted in at checkout under privacy notice v3. It is kept as proof with each recorded consent.
import.smsSummary: SMS consent column: {granted} rows say yes and will be recorded as SMS consent. {notGranted} say no or are blank.
import.emailSummary: Email consent column: {granted} rows say yes and will be recorded as email consent (a row also needs an email address). {notGranted} say no or are blank.
import.labelNumbers: I have consent to message these numbers
import.hintNumbers: Ticked, every number in the file is recorded as having agreed to marketing when you launch the broadcast, with the file name as proof. Unticked, no consent is recorded. People who opted out stay opted out.

proof.title: Prepared proof files
proof.largeHint: The ledger is larger than {max} events, so the file is prepared in the background
proof.large: The ledger holds more than {max} events, more than a direct download carries. Prepare the full file: it is built in the background and you get an email when it is ready.
proof.keptFor: A prepared file can be downloaded for {days} days, then it is deleted. Only one file is prepared at a time.
proof.failed: The file could not be built. Prepare it again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from marketing emails
unsubscribe.intro: Confirm that you no longer want marketing emails from this business. You will still receive messages about your orders and appointments.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will not receive marketing messages from this business any more.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: The unsubscribe link is incomplete or was changed. Use the link in the latest email you received.

marketing_messaging.label: Marketing messages
marketing_messaging.description: Promotions, offers and campaigns. Needs the contact not to have unsubscribed; a recorded opt-in when the workspace requires it.

service_messaging.label: Service messages
service_messaging.description: Replies, order and appointment notices and other messages the customer expects. Not blocked by a marketing unsubscribe.

call_recording.label: Call recording
call_recording.description: Recording and transcribing a call. Needs the recording notice first.

voice_ai_conversation.label: Voice AI conversation
voice_ai_conversation.description: A call handled by an AI voice agent. The caller hears that it is automated first.

ai_content_processing.label: AI processing of messages
ai_content_processing.description: Sending message text to an AI provider to answer, translate or summarise.

analytics_profiling.label: Analytics and profiling
analytics_profiling.description: Scoring and analysing contact activity inside the workspace.

third_party_sharing.label: Sharing with third parties
third_party_sharing.description: Passing personal data to a service outside the platform. Needs a recorded consent.

push_notifications.label: Push notifications
push_notifications.description: Browser notifications to your own team members. The browser permission is the consent.

cookies_analytics.label: Cookies and visitor analytics
cookies_analytics.description: Identifiers for website chat visitors. Needs the visitor to accept first.

staff_ai_assist.label: AI help for your team
staff_ai_assist.description: Draft replies and summaries for agents.

reasons.policy_off: Allowed: the workspace does not require a recorded consent and the contact has not unsubscribed.
reasons.granted: Allowed: a consent is recorded for this channel.
reasons.utility_exempt: Allowed: a service message is not blocked by a marketing unsubscribe.
reasons.inbound_reply_window: Allowed: a reply inside the customer-service window.
reasons.no_grant_required_by_policy: Allowed: this purpose needs no recorded consent.
reasons.gate_unavailable_open: Allowed: the consent check was unavailable and this is a service message.
reasons.no_consent_recorded: Not allowed: the workspace requires a recorded consent and there is none.
reasons.channel_unmapped: Not allowed: a consent cannot be recorded for this channel.
reasons.gate_unavailable_closed: Not allowed: the consent check was unavailable, so marketing is held back.
reasons.purpose_not_applicable: Not allowed: this purpose does not apply to this channel.
reasons.notice_delivered: Allowed: the notice was delivered first.
reasons.consent_evidence_recorded: Allowed: the notice was delivered and the person agreed.
reasons.purpose_not_enabled: Not allowed: the workspace has not switched this on.
reasons.notice_required: A notice must be delivered first.
reasons.subject_minor: Not allowed: this contact is marked as a minor and your workspace holds marketing back.
reasons.sale_share_opted_out: Not allowed: the contact opted out of the sale or sharing of their data.

title.widget: Consent line on the chat form
title.booking: Consent line on the booking page
title.commerce: What the store's marketing checkbox stands for

intro.widget: Shown as a tick box under the visitor's details. Only a visitor who ticks it is recorded as agreeing, and only when they gave a phone number or an email.
intro.booking: Shown as a tick box on the booking form. Only a person who ticks it is recorded as agreeing; booking never needs it.
intro.commerce: A customer who accepts marketing in your store is recorded as agreeing. Write what that checkbox tells them, so the proof names it.
intro.workspace: The wording your workspace shows next to a consent box when a form, widget or booking page has none of its own. Every change is a new numbered version.

notice.textHint: Up to {max} characters. Every change is saved as a new version.
notice.textRequired: Write the wording before switching the line on.
notice.saveFirst: Save this first, then you can set its consent line.
notice.whatsappToo: Also count it as WhatsApp consent (only if the wording says so)
notice.statement: I agree to receive updates and offers on {channels}. I can reply STOP at any time to unsubscribe.
notice.channelsHint: The person is subscribed only on the channels ticked here, and the consent text names them. A channel is used only when the person gives the matching phone number or email.
notice.channelsUse: Update the wording with these channels
